title: Ascent
description: A woman in a long black dress stands on a surreal spiral staircase made of film reels, looking upward as a giant spotlight shines down from above. The cracked walls display floating paintings of a stormy sea, an empty theater, and shattering ice, with film strips and scattered photographs covering the floor.
prompt: A dramatic surreal scene of a woman in a flowing black Victorian dress standing on an ornate spiral staircase constructed from film reels and movie strips. A massive spotlight from above casts strong beams of light. Cracked walls display floating framed paintings: a stormy ocean with a lone figure, an empty vintage theater with red curtains, and shattering ice. Scattered film strips and photographs cover the floor. Twilight sky visible through broken ceiling, cinematic lighting, highly detailed digital painting.
